# Thexis Tech

> Thexis Tech is a Ghanaian technology and software design firm founded in 2023 by Isaac Yanney, specializing in bespoke software design, development, and maintenance for startups, SMEs, and enterprise clients globally.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Web Development**: Custom web applications, e-commerce platforms, CMS solutions, progressive web apps (PWAs), high-performance frontends and backends.
- **Mobile Development**: Native iOS, native Android, and cross-platform (Flutter & React Native) mobile applications.
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: User research, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, design systems, and brand identity design.
- **Data Science & Analytics**: Business intelligence dashboards, data cleaning & pipeline architecture, predictive analytics, and automated reporting.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Scalable cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, database optimization, and high availability systems.
- **IT Consulting & Maintenance**: Security auditing, continuous monitoring, tech advisory, and software lifecycle maintenance.
